$comment: SP01 scene -> reference mapping (PRD Req 7, 'Scene -> reference mapping'). Tower War refs only unless noted. Files live in the ref dir resolved by glob docs/agent_files/*visual-mechanics-overhaul*/ref (override VISUAL_REF_DIR). Each ref: {file, role, items?}; role 'look' = target look, 'chevrons' = only for the listed V-items. A scene may carry an optional `items` list of V-ids (read by visual:score-sheet); later SPs may append scenes (e.g. SP05 l01-tip, pause, results) or refs.
